candidate.client_need: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control
candidate.educational_objective: Recognize a properly ventilated safety cabinet as an engineering control for hazardous-drug preparation that supplements, rather than replaces, appropriate personal protective equipment.

options.A: It is an engineering control used during hazardous-drug preparation, and appropriate personal protective equipment is still required
options.B: It replaces the need for personal protective equipment during hazardous-drug preparation
options.C: Its primary purpose is to store medications after compounding is complete
options.D: It is used mainly to increase compounding speed rather than reduce exposure

candidate.rationale: NIOSH recommends properly ventilated safety cabinets for hazardous-drug preparation and separately directs that appropriate personal protective equipment be provided and used. Thus the cabinet functions as an engineering control but does not replace PPE. B incorrectly treats the cabinet as a substitute for PPE, while C and D misstate its safety purpose.
candidate.source_claim_supported: Properly ventilated safety cabinets are engineering controls for hazardous-drug preparation, and appropriate PPE remains required rather than being replaced by the cabinet.
